passage.text_en:
Subject: Changes to Your Membership

Dear Member,

Starting March 1st, we're introducing new class schedules and extended hours! Our facility will now open at 5:30 AM (previously 6:00 AM) and close at 11:00 PM on weekdays.

Additionally, all members must now reserve spots for group fitness classes through our mobile app at least 2 hours before class time. Walk-ins will only be accepted if space is available.

Your current membership rate will remain unchanged for the next 12 months as a thank you for your loyalty. Questions? Reply to this email or call us at (555) 123-4567.

Best regards,
Fitness First Team
